phase: Rulebook Step 2 — Publication Scope & Source Authority Audit
purpose: Freeze the approved Rulebook Step 2 authority and publication-scope decisions against the current repository inventory snapshot.

supersedes.reason: Repository snapshot refreshed with unchanged Step 2 authority decisions. Structured entity accounting and family digests were recomputed from the selected inventory/source snapshot using stable Foundry/source identity and shared structured-family digest v4.

decisionSource.note: Authority/disposition decisions are preserved from the prior frozen manifest; repository snapshot metadata, authored hashes, structured counts, and structured family digests are regenerated from the selected inventory/current frozen commit.

authoritySemantics.CANONICAL-CANDIDATE + INCLUDE + DECIDED: Accepted authoritative input for this rulebook snapshot.
authoritySemantics.CANONICAL-CANDIDATE + EXCLUDE + DECIDED: Potentially canonical repository content intentionally outside this rulebook snapshot.
authoritySemantics.DERIVATIVE + EXCLUDE + DECIDED: Generated, aggregated, or otherwise derivative content; prohibited as rulebook authority.
authoritySemantics.REFERENCE + EXCLUDE + DECIDED: Contextual or historical reference only; not publication input.
authoritySemantics.NON-CANONICAL + EXCLUDE + DECIDED: Outside reusable System rulebook authority and publication scope.

publicationRules.structuredSourceAuthority: src/packs structured Foundry JSON is the canonical publication input for structured families.
publicationRules.generatedMkDocsAuthority: Generated MkDocs detail pages and dynamic aggregation outputs are DERIVATIVE and EXCLUDED. Hand-authored MkDocs source pages are evaluated individually and may be authoritative only when explicitly INCLUDE + DECIDED.
publicationRules.generatedContentMethod: Generate rulebook presentation directly from structured src/packs data; do not scrape or round-trip through generated MkDocs output.
publicationRules.campaignBoundary: Campaign/adventure-specific material is excluded unless explicitly elevated by a later authority decision.
publicationRules.frontMatterPolicy: The hand-authored site landing pages docs/gm-facing/index.md (A015) and docs/player-facing/index.md (A032) are explicit canonical publication inputs for Front Matter / Navigation. Their inclusion is an explicit exception to any prior blanket exclusion of MkDocs landing/navigation pages.
publicationRules.fastPlayPolicy: For adversaries and environments, consume flags.cybermancy.fastPlay structurally and render it as Fast Play; do not flatten it into Description.
